subject: HOF Gen7 reversal/reacquisition guard: cross-gap pseudo-reversal + 30-70 oscillation scope
body:
GEN7 RESEARCH HANDOFF — PresentationHinge reversal / reacquisition / oscillation guard correctness.

APPLIES TO
- repo: boberino93-bit/duo-open
- exact main HEAD inspected: 633c75be26001d5a4ef6e04c7696e8246713be44
- evidence: SOURCE + MODEL
- FIELD: none in this lane; physical Fold7 validation still required
- production Git writes: none

EXECUTIVE FINDING
The current Gen5 visual hinge can infer a reversal across a long trusted-geometry blackout and can arm its 850 ms OSCILLATION_GUARD after repeated reversals anywhere in the 0-180 degree range. Both are inconsistent with the Gen7 Presentation Hinge causal contract. A long reacquisition gap destroys direction continuity, so the first post-gap segment cannot itself prove a trusted reversal. The Gen7 directive also scopes repeated long-guard oscillation to the 30-70 degree region rather than any two reversals anywhere on the hinge.

SOURCE EVIDENCE
1) app/src/main/java/com/duoopen/fold/Fold7VirtualHingeGen5.kt detects REACQUIRE_GAP_NS, sets reacquireUntilNs, but then still computes velocity against the pre-gap previous sample and compares that sign against the pre-gap lastDirectionSign. lastDirectionSign and reversal history are not invalidated when the gap is detected.
2) chooseDesired precedence is OSCILLATION_GUARD -> REVERSAL_GUARD -> REACQUIRE. A single first post-gap sample can therefore be both reacquiring and reversing, with REVERSAL_GUARD winning.
3) reversalTimesNs counts every detected reversal and enters OSCILLATION_GUARD after two timestamps inside OSCILLATION_WINDOW_NS=500 ms. There is no 30-70 degree band check. Current constants include REVERSAL_GUARD_NS=55 ms, OSCILLATION_GUARD_NS=850 ms, REACQUIRE_GAP_NS=120 ms.

MODEL REPRODUCTION A — cross-gap pseudo-reversal
Trace: 40 deg @0 ms -> 50 deg @20 ms -> blackout -> 40 deg @240 ms. Current Gen5 behavioral mirror reports reacquiring=true AND reversal=true; effective state immediately after sample is REVERSAL_GUARD. Candidate reports reacquiring=true, reversal=false, effective state REACQUIRE.

MODEL REPRODUCTION B — out-of-band long guard
Trace: 120 -> 130 -> 120 -> 130 deg inside 60 ms. Current mirror enters OSCILLATION_GUARD although all motion is outside 30-70. Candidate still permits short trusted-reversal damping but does not count these reversals toward the long oscillation guard.

POSITIVE CONTROL
Trace: 40 -> 55 -> 45 -> 58 deg. Candidate enters OSCILLATION_GUARD, preserving intended repeated in-band protection.

ADVERSARIAL COVERAGE
Seven tests pass: exact Gen5 cross-gap reproduction; candidate cross-gap correction; exact Gen5 out-of-band long-guard reproduction; candidate out-of-band correction; candidate positive in-band guard; 10,000 randomized cross-gap traces proving first post-gap sample never reports reversal; and 10,000 randomized out-of-band reversal sequences proving they never arm the long candidate oscillation guard. This is MODEL evidence, not device evidence.

RECOMMENDED GEN7 CONTROL CONTRACT
1. On a trusted-geometry gap entering REACQUIRE, invalidate direction continuity before reversal evaluation.
2. Do not use the cross-gap segment itself as trusted reversal evidence.
3. Require fresh post-gap samples to re-establish direction sign.
4. Retain short REVERSAL_GUARD across the physical range only for reversals established from continuous trusted samples.
5. Count reversals toward long OSCILLATION_GUARD only when the relevant reversal samples/pivots are in 30-70 degrees.
6. Clear long-guard reversal history when leaving that band or when trusted geometry continuity breaks.
7. Preserve presentation attempt identity; guard states must never mutate semantic hinge or panel authority.
8. Emit distinct causal reasons: reacquire_gap, trusted_reversal, oscillation_band_reversal, prediction_disagreement.

WHY THIS MATTERS
A false cross-gap reversal suppresses ordinary reacquisition correction for the first 55 ms, and repeated false signs can escalate into an 850 ms visual hold exactly where the presentation-only predictor should represent uncertainty as REACQUIRE rather than promote it into stronger reversal evidence.

DISPOSITION
- current Gen5 behavior vs Gen7 intended contract: FAIL (SOURCE + MODEL)
- candidate guard logic vs included suite: PASS (MODEL)
- physical Fold7 validation: UNKNOWN / REQUIRED
- recommendation: promote for Primary consideration in the clean Gen7 PresentationHinge, not by modifying semantic-authority classes.

ADJACENT SEPARATE LANE
The same Gen5 source permits fitted hinge velocity up to 900 deg/s while capping visual slew at 480 deg/s. At 120 Hz the renderer can therefore fall progressively behind sufficiently fast trusted/synthetic motion. This should be investigated as a separate Gen7 frame-time/rate-envelope lane and is not part of this handoff acceptance claim.
